summary: A bundled 'imagegen' system skill (feature flag image_generation: stable, true) generates an image from a natural-language prompt in headless `codex exec` sessions; not exposed as a documented CLI flag or subcommand.
invocation: codex exec --sandbox workspace-write "Generate a <image> and save it as <file>.png ... Use your image generation skill if you have one."
limitations: No documented CLI flag or subcommand triggers it; invocation is a natural-language prompt the model routes to the bundled imagegen skill.
The underlying image model was not named in the transcript that produced the live-verified output; gpt-image-2 is inferred from release notes, not confirmed.
Not documented in `codex --help`, any subcommand `--help`, or official OpenAI Codex docs; evidence is a live local run plus release-note corroboration, not vendor documentation.

evidence.claim: Release notes reference an 'imagegen' bundled system skill updated for gpt-image-2 (rust-v0.124.0: 'Update imagegen system skill'; rust-v0.128.0: bundled OpenAI Docs skill updated for gpt-image-2), corroborating the feature-flagged image_generation capability observed live.

summary: gemini-cli has no built-in image-synthesis command out of the box; image generation is reached either by installing the community 'nanobanana' extension (extensions.plugins) or by routing a prompt to an image-capable model via -m (e.g. gemini-3.1-flash-image) — neither path is documented as a first-class gemini-cli feature.
invocation: gemini -p "<prompt>" -m gemini-3.1-flash-image --yolo -o text  (undocumented, AOS-observed model-routing path)
limitations: geminicli.com/docs documents no built-in image synthesis command; both invocation paths above are extension- or model-routing-based, not a native CLI feature.

Neither path was live-verified end-to-end (does it save an image file headlessly) in this session; this row is inferred from official model docs plus a community extension's README, not a confirmed local run.
The nanobanana extension is community-maintained (gemini-cli-extensions org), not published by Google.

evidence.claim: Documents the Nano Banana image-generation model family (gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3-pro-image-preview) reachable through Gemini clients, including gemini-cli via -m model routing.
Community gemini-cli extension adding /generate, /edit, /icon and related image commands backed by Nano Banana models, installed via `gemini extensions install`.
